title: Ideal Gases and Kinetic Molecular Theory
requiredLabVisualSimulationEvidence: Gas behavior data/model investigation using gas particle models and P-V-T data. No pressure vessels or physical gas experiments are required.
simulationVirtualLabReviewRequirement: Required for thermochemistry, gas behavior, phase changes, and solutions
directSimulationStudentTask: After the simulation opens, use the gas container model with pressure, volume, temperature, and particle controls. Set a starting condition and record pressure, volume, temperature, and particle amount. Change only one variable at a time while keeping the other variables as constant as the simulation allows. Record before-and-after values and state the gas-law relationship shown by the model.
simulationReviewImplementation: Student-facing lesson includes one exact direct simulation/resource link plus adjacent step-by-step directions for what to open, click/use, observe, record, and connect to the lesson standard.
simulationSourceReference: PhET Gas Properties; Concord Consortium; OpenStax Chemistry 2e
